name: pm-investing-literacy
description: Financial literacy for reading company accounts: a beginner's tutor for an uploaded annual report, an audited-boundary check on every headline figure, a profit-to-cash walk with the arithmetic shown, a same-definitions comparison of two companies, and a vocabulary explainer anchored to the document. Every figure carries a page reference and anything missing is marked not disclosed. Educational — not financial advice; decisions with real money belong with a regulated adviser.
